snippet.title: Why Military Aircraft Use Two Opposite Spinning Propellers
snippet.description:
Why do aircraft like the Tu-95 have two propellers spinning in opposite directions?

It’s not just for balance.

Single propellers create swirling airflow that wastes engine power and can even twist the aircraft during takeoff. So engineers solved the problem with contra-rotating propellers — turning wasted energy into pure forward thrust.

A simple idea that made some military aircraft far more efficient and powerful.

snippet.title: James Webb Just Looked at Pluto for the First Time — And What It Found Is Insane
snippet.description:
🪐 Pluto. The frozen world we thought was dead… and that could 
be hiding an ocean deep within its darkness.

But what's truly unsettling isn't that it exists. What's truly 
unsettling is that it might be far more alive than we ever imagined.

Over 5 billion kilometers from Earth lies a world where sunlight 
takes more than five hours to arrive. A place so cold that nitrogen 
freezes into mountains of ice, where temperatures drop to -225°C, 
and where, for decades, scientists believed absolutely nothing 
was happening.

However, the James Webb Space Telescope has just changed that story.

In this cinematic documentary, we'll explore the surprising 
discoveries made about Pluto, the dwarf planet that's challenging 
everything we thought we knew about the outer solar system. We'll 
analyze the strange anomalies detected by James Webb, the possible 
existence of a hidden ocean beneath kilometers of ice, the 
mysterious organic compounds found on its surface, and the 
unsettling possibility that Pluto is far more complex than we 
ever imagined.

🔴 What you'll discover in this video:
▸ Why Pluto stopped being considered a planet in 2006
▸ What the historic New Horizons mission revealed in 2015
▸ The surprising findings from the James Webb Space Telescope
▸ What tholins are and why they could be important for the origin of life
▸ The strange thermal anomalies detected on its surface
▸ The possible existence of a liquid ocean hidden beneath the ice
▸ Why Pluto might not be a dead world after all
▸ How this discovery could change our search for extraterrestrial life
